mapper.sql: c.id, c.name, c.teacher_id, c.description, u.real_name AS teacher_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course c JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.teacher_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM course c JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.teacher_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT FROM course c JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.teacher_id JOIN enrollment e ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
SELECT id FROM enrollment WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, u.real_name AS teacher_name, CASE WHEN running.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN latest.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'NOT_TAKEN' END AS exam_status, running.id AS active_attempt_id, latest.id AS latest_attempt_id, latest.score AS latest_score, latest.total_score AS latest_total_score FROM enrollment e JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN exam_attempt running ON running.course_id = c.id AND running.student_id = e.student_id AND running.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' LEFT JOIN exam_attempt latest ON latest.course_id = c.id AND latest.student_id = e.student_id
AND latest.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_attempt newer WHERE newer.course_id = latest.course_id AND newer.student_id = latest.student_id AND newer.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND newer.attempt_no > latest.attempt_no) WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY c.id
